snippet.title: Kinda Hard Golf - Gameplay Montage
snippet.description:
Play it free at 🎮  https://kindahardgolf.com

Kinda Hard Golf is a free daily web game that blends golf with platforming. Each day brings a new, short-but-tough hole where players try to get to the top in as few shots as possible. Play it free on web, no download required! (But be warned, it's addictive).
